name: Exed Out of My Story
overview: Evelyn Scott, once the heiress of the Scotts, had her place stolen by her half-sister, Lydia. She spent three years chasing Jonas Ford, unaware he was heir to the powerful Ford family and only approached her because of Lydia. After sacrificing everything and enduring endless betrayal, Evelyn finally lets go of her feelings for Jonas... just when he starts to want her for real.  (Source: DramaBoxdb)
